Always start by reading [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md). Review domain docs before changes; get module-owner/platform-team approval for cross-cutting concerns; record architecture decisions in `DECISIONS/` using an ADR.

Docs: central `docs/` is Russian; public contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, crate `README.md` are English. Mixed language within a single document is not allowed — choose one language per file. Platform docs in `docs/`; component docs in `apps/<name>/docs/` or `crates/<name>/docs/`. Every app/crate root `README.md` must cover purpose, responsibilities, interactions, entry points, and link to `docs/`. `docs/modules/_index.md` links all module docs.

For architecture, API, events, modules, tenancy, routing, UI contracts, or observability changes: update component docs, central docs, and [`docs/index.md`](docs/index.md); update [`docs/modules/registry.md`](docs/modules/registry.md) for added/renamed modules/apps; mark outdated docs `deprecated` or `archived` and point to replacements.

Do not create a new document when an existing one is suitable — extend it instead.
Documentation must reflect the actual state of the code.
Never bypass or disable pre-commit/pre-push hooks. Fix the root cause of failures.
Do not edit CI/CD workflow files unless explicitly requested.
Do not modify other branches — only work on the assigned task branch.
